# DSH-Mem0
**English** | 简体中文
A universal Mem0 long-term memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH).
Repository: <https://github.com/light-cheng/DSH-Mem0>
Three backends are supported:
- **Mem0 Platform**: the managed Mem0 API; only an API key is required, and it is the best fit for m

ost users.
- **Self-hosted server**: connect to your own Mem0 REST service.
- **OSS Python sidecar**
: reuse a local Mem0 Python SDK / Qdrant / embedding setup, suitable for local bge-m3, Qdrant and si
milar self-hosted environments.
## Features
- **Automatic recall**: on every turn, the latest real user message is used to search for related me
mories, injected into the model context as a `<mem0-relevant-memories>` data block. A failed or time

d-out search never blocks the model request.
- **Automatic capture and filtering**: after a turn com
pletes normally, the turn's user messages and the final assistant reply (not the intermediate narrat
ion between tool calls) are handed to Mem0 for fact extraction and storage, so long tool-heavy turns
are still captured; interrupted, failed or rejected turns are not saved. The default heuristic filt

er skips greetings, short acknowledgements and command-only turns to reduce low-value memories.
- **
Editable memory summary**: a structured summary is derived from stored memories, ranked by pinned/im
portance metadata and then freshness (newer facts first, decaying over roughly 90 days; text length
only breaks ties), and injected before relevant memories. It has its own token budget, can be edited
directly in the settings page, and can be read or rewritten by the agent through `mem0_profile_get`
/ `mem0_profile_update` / `mem0_profile_reset`. Manual edits survive weekly hygiene; **Rebuild from

memories** restores the generated version.
- **Memory budgets and weekly hygiene**: recall memories
and the profile each have a token budget; a memory hygiene pass runs every 7 days by default to ded
uplicate and prune the oldest over-budget memories. It only ever deletes memories written by this pl
ugin (`metadata.source: "dsh"`), and automatic passes only preview until you confirm a manual run in

the settings page.
- **Explicit tools**: `mem0_search`, `mem0_add`, `mem0_get`, `mem0_update`, `mem
0_delete`, `mem0_status`, plus `mem0_profile_get`, `mem0_profile_update`, `mem0_profile_reset` for t

he memory summary.
- **Switchable backends**: Platform, self-hosted server and local OSS sidecar sha

re the same tools and automatic memory logic.
[该节后续省略]
## UI
After installation, open **Plugins** in the DSH sidebar and open **Mem0 Memory** under **Installed p
lugins**. You can choose a backend, inspect live connection status and save settings directly in the
bundle detail page:
Each backend has its own fields and guidance:
The **Test connection** button calls the same read-only health check as `mem0_status`, showing the c
urrent backend, collection, Python/Mem0/Qdrant/Embedder status, and never the API key.
**Memory summary** is the editable summary injected before relevant memories. It is shown as structu
red sections; use **Edit summary** to edit it and **Rebuild from memories** to regenerate it from th
e store. Manual edits survive weekly hygiene.
**Memory activity** records the latest automatic capture and recall results; **Recent memories** rea
ds the backend directly and shows real memory text, ID and time. This makes it clear whether automat
ic capture actually worked. A capture that ran but wrote nothing (no memory added, updated or delete
d) shows a grey **Nothing new** badge instead of the green **Saved**, and the composer status says *
*Nothing new to remember**. Platform and server answers that report no counts keep the **Saved** bad
thing new to remember**. Platform and server answers that report no counts keep the **Saved** badge.
[该节后续省略]
## Memory maintenance
The **Memory maintenance** section separates several budgets that are easy to confuse:
- **Memory summary budget**: upper bound for the `<mem0-user-profile>` block, 1375 tokens by default

.
- **Recall memory budget**: upper bound for the `<mem0-relevant-memories>` block, 2200 tokens by d

ory budget**: upper bound for the `<mem0-relevant-memories>` block, 2200 tokens by default.
[该节后续省略]

## Privacy and data
**What leaves this machine**
| Backend / feature | Sent | To |
| Platform | Captured conversation text (user and assistant messages, redacted and truncated; with `
captureStrataFolds`, also redacted dsh-strata fold summaries with metadata `via`, `fold`, `tier`), r
ecall queries, `userId`/`agentId`, metadata `source`, `channel`, `session_id` | `https://api.mem0.ai

` (or your `baseUrl`) |
| Server | The same | Your self-hosted Mem0 server |
| OSS | The same, via a
loopback-only sidecar | The LLM, embedder and vector store in your `oss.json`; if those are cloud A

PIs (e.g. OpenAI), the text goes there |
| Memory translation (`translateMemories`, off by default)
| Memory text shown on the settings page, up to the full list when the memory browser opens | DSH's
current default model, which may be a cloud model |
The working directory is not sent. With `backend: auto`, an inherited `MEM0_API_KEY` alone selects t
he Platform; check "backend choice" in `mem0_status` or the settings page.
**What is stored locally**
- `<DSH profile>/dsh-mem0/maintenance.json` (mode 0600): the memory summary text and hygiene reports

. Reports keep only memory ids, counts and reasons, not the text of deleted memories.
- `<DSH profil
e>/dsh-mem0/failures.json` (mode 0600): the last 20 memory failures (time, kind, backend, cause, fai
ling component, duration, short message). Messages are redacted and shortened before they are stored

: no API keys, tokens, memory text or home-directory paths. Delete the file to clear the history.
-
`<DSH profile>/dsh-mem0/sidecar.log` (mode 0600, OSS backend only): the sidecar's stderr plus its st
art and exit events (exit code or signal, uptime). Each line is redacted before it is written (keys,
tokens; home-directory paths shortened to `~`). LLM answers are never logged (only their length and
how they start), and Mem0 warnings that quote memory or message text are scrubbed. Capped at 512 KB

, with one rotated copy `sidecar.log.1`. Delete both files to clear it.
[该节后续省略]
